prompt: Call the 6-and-under tee-ball season opener like a WWE main event, commentary table and all.
response:
**[Camera swoops over a dew-covered community ballfield. Folding chairs packed along the baseline. A cooler lid slams shut. Somewhere, a parent is already yelling “GOOD EYE!” at a child facing a stationary ball.]**

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the most electrifying morning in sports entertainment! We are LIVE from Field 3 behind the rec center for the 6-and-under tee-ball season opener!

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** I’ve got goosebumps, partner. The chalk lines are crooked, the dugout snacks are orange slices, and there’s a non-zero chance a left fielder is currently looking for a bug.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** And here comes the home team! The Mighty Mudcats! Look at that entrance!

**[A line of five-year-olds jogs in from the third-base side. Two are wearing batting helmets. One is wearing a catcher’s mask backward. One has stopped to hug grandma.]**

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** That’s veteran composure right there. You don’t ignore grandma on opening day.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Starting things off for the visiting Fireflies is number 7, “Big” Mason Thompson. And by Big, we mean he is wearing size 1 cleats and carrying a bat roughly the length of a telephone pole.

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** Mason’s got juice. I saw him in warmups hit one four feet past the tee. That’s raw power.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** The coach sets the ball on the tee. Mason steps in. Helmet tilted over one eye. Crowd rising to its feet—mostly because someone spilled coffee in the second row.

**[Mason swings. Misses the ball. Hits the tee. The tee wobbles but survives.]**

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** OH MY GOODNESS! HE JUST SENT A MESSAGE TO THAT TEE!

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** That tee has a family! You can’t come out here in week one and establish dominance like that!

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Second swing now. Mason digs in. He points toward… actually he’s pointing at the playground.

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** Mind games.

**[He swings and dribbles the ball three feet toward the pitcher’s mound.]**

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** CONTACT! THE BALL IS LIVE! CHAOS HAS BEEN UNLEASHED!

**[Every infielder charges. The pitcher fields it, drops it, picks it up, turns in a full circle, throws it toward first. The first baseman is sitting down drawing in the dirt.]**

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** Textbook defensive confusion! You drill that all week and still can’t prepare for game speed!

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Mason is halfway to first! He’s looking at his mom! He’s slowing down—NO! Coach is waving him on! Mason touches first base! The Fireflies have a baserunner!

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** That’s how legends are born: one infield single and three adults yelling contradictory instructions.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Up next, number 12, Harper “The Hammer” Diaz. She enters the box with pink cleats, unicorn sunglasses, and absolutely no fear.

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** I watched Harper during the pregame. She was eating a granola bar and staring through the opposing dugout. Ice cold.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** The pitch—well, the placement—is made. Harper swings!

**[CRACK. The ball rolls sharply between third and short.]**

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** SHE GOT ALL OF THAT! A SCREAMER INTO NO-MAN’S-LAND!

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** The shortstop’s giving chase, but he’s been distracted by his own glove. That’s a veteran glove, too—still has the tag on it.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Mason is heading for second! Harper racing to first! The third baseman has the ball! He’s throwing to… home plate?

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** Bold strategy. There was no runner headed home, but you have to admire the ambition.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Safe everywhere! The Fireflies are cooking!

**[Camera cuts to the Mudcats’ dugout. One player is upside down on the bench. Another is asking if it’s snack time.]**

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** You can feel the pressure mounting. The Mudcats need leadership. They need focus. They need someone to stop pouring Gatorade into a helmet.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** Bottom of the first now, and here comes the Mudcats’ leadoff hitter, number 3, Liam “Lightning” Brooks!

**[Liam runs from the dugout to the batter’s box, then keeps running past it toward third base.]**

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** HE’S GOT TOO MUCH SPEED! SOMEBODY PUT A LEASH ON LIGHTNING!

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** That’s the thing about Liam. Tremendous motor. Limited directional awareness.

**[Coach redirects him. Liam gets set. Swings. The ball pops off the tee and lands directly in front of home plate.]**

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** A bunt! A PERFECTLY EXECUTED SURPRISE BUNT!

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** Was it intentional? Absolutely not. Was it effective? In tee-ball, that’s the whole scouting report.

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** The catcher picks it up! The catcher is running to first! He still has his mask on sideways! Liam is hustling! The race is on!

**[The catcher stops halfway to adjust his shoe. Liam reaches first.]**

**PLAY-BY-PLAY:** SAFE! LIGHTNING STRIKES FIRST!

**COLOR COMMENTATOR:** You cannot teach that
